PAGE TITLE: FINANCIAL SECTION | LETTER FROM THE INSPECTOR GENERAL ON AUDIT
Letter from the Inspector General on Audit

KEY FACTS:
- Date of letter: November 15, 2024
- TO: Bill Nelson, Administrator; Margaret Vo Schaus, Chief Financial Officer
- SUBJECT: Audit of NASA’s Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Statements (Report No. IG-25-001; Assignment No. A-24-05-00-FMD)
- Independent public accounting firm: Ernst & Young LLP (EY)
- Audit result: "clean" or unmodified opinion on NASA’s FY 2024 financial statements
- EY reported one material weakness in internal control related to financial reporting oversight
- EY reported no instances of significant noncompliance with applicable laws and regulations for FY 2024
